const z = S.zhuda; const [x, y] = S.project(z.center); S.press(1, x, y); for (let k = 0; k < 30; k++) { S.move(1, x + 2 * k, y + 3 * k); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 40)); } return JSON.stringify({ held: z.state, feet: z.feet.map(v => +v.toFixed(2)) });
S.release(1); const z = S.zhuda; z.respawn(); return JSON.stringify(z.feet.map(v => +v.toFixed(1)));
